title: Large Reported CHB-MIT Adaptation Gains Disappear with Pretrained Encoders and Matched Probes
abstract: arXiv:2611.26929v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dani and Liebe (2026) (DL) report that adapting the final encoder block of BIOT and CBraMod with self-supervised learning (SSL) improves CHB-MIT seizure-detection ROC-AUC by 36.2 and 29.5 points over linear probing. We investigate these results with their released code and an independent pipeline. The release loads pretrained weights for adaptation only when an otherwise unset configuration key is supplied, and its CBraMod probe reads the reconstruction head with dropout active. translated_title: 使用预训练编码器与匹配探测方法后，文献中报告的CHB-MIT大幅适应增益消失
translated_abstract: Dani 和 Liebe（2026）（简称DL）报告称，通过自监督学习（SSL）对BIOT和CBraMod的最后一个编码器块进行适应微调，相比线性探测可将CHB-MIT癫痫发作检测的ROC-AUC分别提升36.2和29.5个点。我们使用其发布的代码和一条独立流程对这些结果进行了复现研究。结果发现，该代码库只有在提供了一个原本未设置的配置键时才会为适应微调加载预训练权重，且其CBraMod探测头在dropout处于激活状态下读取重建头的输出。在正确进行预训练初始化、并在评估模式下对编码器输出施加探测的情况下，在DL的数据划分上，五个随机种子下的固定配方适应增益为：BIOT为-0.6个点（95%区间[-3.8, +2.6]），CBraMod为+0.01（[-0.02, +0.04]）。在DL的数据划分以及CHB-MIT和Siena头皮脑电数据集的五种受试者轮换设置下，使用同等调优的线性探测（30种配置、最多500轮、基于验证集的早停），平均适应效应范围为-1.1至……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过复现发现，Dani和Liebe声称的SSL微调在CHB-MIT癫痫检测上带来的36.2和29.5点ROC-AUC提升，实际上是配置错误（预训练权重未被正确加载、探测时dropout未关闭）造成的假象——在正确设置下适应增益几乎完全消失。
en_tdlr: The reported 36.2- and 29.5-point CHB-MIT adaptation gains from SSL fine-tuning vanish (-0.6 to +0.01 points) when pretrained encoders are properly initialized and evaluated with matched linear probes, indicating the original improvements were artifacts of configuration errors rather than genuine benefits of adaptation.
